description: This file defines a custom layout manager class for Swing GUI applications, extending FlowLayout to customize size calculations of container components.

classes.name: CustomToolbarLayout
classes.description: A custom Swing layout manager extending FlowLayout, providing specific implementations for calculating minimum and preferred sizes based on child components.

methods.name: minimumLayoutSize
methods.description: Returns the minimum size needed for the container, computed based on the smallest dimensions of visible child components.

methods.name: preferredLayoutSize
methods.description: Returns the preferred size for the container, calculated based on the preferred sizes of child components.

methods.name: computeSize
methods.description: Calculates the preferred size of the container, considering flow layout logic and container insets.

methods.name: computeMinSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum size of the container based on the smallest preferred size of its visible components.
